task.description: Implement the GH #2739 design: TypeAccess.denial_query shared base + visible_to/2; Definitions.list_definitions/3 replaces /2; router passes auth user id. No tests written.

result.summary: Implemented per design. TypeAccess: private denial_query/1 (restriction left-join grant, is_nil(g.id), user cast type(^user_id, Ecto.UUID)) used by authorized?/3, denied_types/3 and new public visible_to/2 (is_binary user_id, is_atom binding; dynamic not exists(denial where r.entity_type == parent_as(^binding).name)). Definitions.list_definitions/3(user_id, filters, prefix): from(e in EntityDefinition, as: :def), tenant_id, keyset, visible_to, order_by, limit page_size+1; /2 removed; alias TypeAccess added. Router handle_list_definitions passes conn.assigns.auth_context.user_id; stale /2 mentions updated in entities.ex and query/cursor.ex. MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean, mix format applied, mix letflow.check_boundaries OK (1373 edges, 0 violations). Tests NOT run (per instructions). SQL-level rendering of the EXISTS subquery was only partially checked (query struct builds with exists(%SubQuery{}) and parent_as(:def)); T-12 (prefix propagation) remains the runtime gate.
